title: FormatNumber
description: Comprehensive number formatting with compact notation, currency, time, and more

import { Code } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

## Overview

FormatNumber provides utilities for formatting numbers into human-readable strings. Includes compact notation (K, M, B, T), currency, time, file sizes, ordinals, and Roman numerals.

## Usage

### Compact Notation

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.Abbreviate(1500)        -- "1.5K"
FormatNumber.Abbreviate(1500000)     -- "1.5M"
FormatNumber.Abbreviate(1500000000) -- "1.5B"
FormatNumber.Abbreviate(1234567890123) -- "1.2T"

-- Custom decimals
FormatNumber.Abbreviate(1234567, 2)  -- "1.23M"
```

### Thousands Separators

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.WithCommas(1234567)     -- "1,234,567"
FormatNumber.WithCommas(1000)        -- "1,000"
FormatNumber.WithCommas(999)         -- "999"
```

### Currency

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.Currency(1234.5)              -- "$1,234.50"
FormatNumber.Currency(1234.5, '£')         -- "£1,234.50"
FormatNumber.Currency(-500)                -- "-$500.00"
```

### Percentages

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.Percentage(0.85)        -- "85%"
FormatNumber.Percentage(0.8567, 2)   -- "85.67%"
FormatNumber.Percentage(1.5, 1)      -- "150.0%"
```

### Time Formatting

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

-- HH:MM:SS format
FormatNumber.Time(3665)              -- "1:01:05"
FormatNumber.Time(65)                -- "1:05"
FormatNumber.Time(3665, true)        -- "1:01:05" (force hours)

-- Compact time
FormatNumber.TimeCompact(9000)       -- "2h 30m"
FormatNumber.TimeCompact(3665)       -- "1h 1m 5s"
FormatNumber.TimeCompact(65, false)  -- "1m" (no seconds)
```

### File Sizes

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.FileSize(1024)           -- "1.0 KB"
FormatNumber.FileSize(1536000)        -- "1.5 MB"
FormatNumber.FileSize(1073741824)     -- "1.0 GB"
```

### Ordinals

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.Ordinal(1)    -- "1st"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(2)    -- "2nd"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(3)    -- "3rd"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(4)    -- "4th"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(21)   -- "21st"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(22)   -- "22nd"
FormatNumber.Ordinal(23)   -- "23rd"
```

### Roman Numerals

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

FormatNumber.ToRoman(1994)   -- "MCMXCIV"
FormatNumber.ToRoman(2024)   -- "MMXXIV"
FormatNumber.ToRoman(3999)   -- "MMMCMXCIX"

-- Parse back
FormatNumber.FromRoman("MCMXCIV") -- 1994
FormatNumber.FromRoman("INVALID") -- nil
```

### Math Utilities

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local FormatNumber = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.FormatNumber)

-- Rounding
FormatNumber.Round(3.14159, 2)   -- 3.14
FormatNumber.Round(3.14159, 0)   -- 3

-- Clamping
FormatNumber.Clamp(150, 0, 100)  -- 100
FormatNumber.Clamp(-10, 0, 100)  -- 0

-- Lerp
FormatNumber.Lerp(0, 100, 0.5)   -- 50
FormatNumber.Lerp(0, 100, 1.5)   -- 100 (clamped)

-- Padding
FormatNumber.Pad(42, 4)          -- "0042"
FormatNumber.Pad(12345, 4)       -- "12345"
```

## API Reference

| Function | Signature | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| `WithCommas` | `(number) -> string` | Add thousands separators |
| `Abbreviate` | `(number, decimals?) -> string` | Compact with K/M/B/T suffixes |
| `Round` | `(number, decimals?) -> number` | Round to decimal places |
| `Currency` | `(number, symbol?) -> string` | Format as currency |
| `Percentage` | `(number, decimals?) -> string` | Format as percentage |
| `Time` | `(seconds, showHours?) -> string` | HH:MM:SS format |
| `TimeCompact` | `(seconds, showSeconds?) -> string` | "2h 30m" format |
| `FileSize` | `(bytes, decimals?) -> string` | Human-readable file size |
| `Clamp` | `(number, min, max) -> number` | Clamp between range |
| `Lerp` | `(a, b, t) -> number` | Linear interpolation |
| `Pad` | `(number, length) -> string` | Leading zero padding |
| `Ordinal` | `(number) -> string` | 1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc. |
| `ToRoman` | `(number) -> string` | Convert to Roman numerals (up to 3999) |
| `FromRoman` | `(string) -> number?` | Parse Roman numeral |

## Suffix Reference (Abbreviate)

| Tier | Suffix | Value |
|------|--------|-------|
| 1 | K | Thousand (10³) |
| 2 | M | Million (10⁶) |
| 3 | B | Billion (10⁹) |
| 4 | T | Trillion (10¹²) |
| 5 | Qa | Quadrillion (10¹⁵) |
| 6 | Qi | Quintillion (10¹⁸) |
| 7 | Sx | Sextillion (10²¹) |
| 8 | Sp | Septillion (10²⁴) |
| 9 | Oc | Octillion (10²⁷) |
| 10 | No | Nonillion (10³⁰) |
| 11 | De | Decillion (10³³) |

## Best Practices

- **Use `Abbreviate`** for large resource counts (money, XP, damage)
- **Use `WithCommas`** for player-facing scores under 1 million
- **Use `Currency`** for shop prices and economy displays
- **Use `TimeCompact`** for buff/ability cooldown timers
- **Use `Ordinal`** for rankings and achievement tiers
- **Cache formatted strings** in reactive UI to avoid re-formatting every frame
- **Handle `FromRoman` returning nil** for invalid inputs
